title: Conjunctivitis—Dogs

content_blocks.text: Inflammation of the conjunctiva, the vascularized mucous membrane that covers the anterior sclera (bulbar conjunctiva), lines the eyelids (palpebral conjunctiva), and lines the third eyelid.

Irritant-induced conjunctivitis—flush ocular surfaces and remove foreign body if observed.

Allergic or follicular conjunctivitis—apply viscous artificial tear gel to both eyes before patient is active outdoors (q8–12h), then flush ocular surface with eye wash when returning indoors to remove “trapped” allergens.
